coaches.name: Renee
coaches.specialties: Sound healing · Reiki · Breathwork · Meditation · Yin yoga · NLP
coaches.bio: Renee creates safe, nurturing spaces where people can slow down, reconnect with themselves, and restore balance. Her approach combines compassionate presence with breathwork, meditation, Reiki, sound healing, and other whole-person practices.

coaches.name: Carley
coaches.specialties: Personal training · Hatha yoga · Functional nutrition
coaches.bio: Carley is the founder of Deeply Rooted Coaching and has a background in exercise science. She combines movement, nutrition, mindset, nervous-system regulation, and body awareness to help people feel strong, grounded, and at home in themselves.

coaches.name: Priscilla
coaches.specialties: Trauma-informed counselling · Breathwork · Reiki · Energy healing
coaches.bio: Priscilla creates compassionate, grounded spaces for people to explore difficult emotions, build self-awareness, and reconnect with their own strength. Her work integrates breathwork, counselling, Reiki, energy healing, and spiritual guidance.

coaches.name: Zoë
coaches.specialties: Former registered nurse · Breathwork · Consciousness coaching · Yoga
coaches.bio: After more than twelve years as a registered nurse, Zoë trained in yoga, coaching, personal training, energy healing, and transformational breathwork. Through Flowstate with Zoë, she offers practical tools for nervous-system regulation, clarity, balance, and everyday wellbeing.
